book.name: MARKUS
book.title: MARKUS Markus nu pasa mayenu Yesus Kristus tuku kuyarna

content: Yohanus kule pisne taŋgo pasa kuklina
Kuate tuku Kiŋo Yesus Kristus tuku pasa mayenu ta
tuan taŋgo Aisaia nu teŋenmba kuyarna le minit.

content.text: Ne isa. Ye taŋgo ande kukuli le nu amboŋga promba ne tuku ndin wakeiyamŋgat.
Ma baknu mbolŋge wi ande kueŋka teŋenmba sakate. Suŋgo tuku ndin wakeimba kuanekap. Nu likam tuku ndin te-tiwap ŋgate. Aisaia 40.3

content: Yohanus kule pisne taŋgo nu pasa ta kumumba ma baknu mbolŋge minmba pasa kuklimba taŋgo nane ŋgamuŋgal biye mbilmba maŋau ŋaigonu kusreka kule pisne tuwaig le Kuate nu nane tuku une sauka gilaiŋgamŋgat ŋga saka minna.

Nu taŋamba minna le Yerusalem mbal Yudea tumbraŋ yimyam nane ŋakmba nu tugum prowe likinaig. Nane naŋgine une maŋau kile-mayokke likinaig le Yohanus nu ndek Yordan kule mbolŋge nane kule pisneniŋmba minna.
Yohanus nu kamel ŋguenu ŋak tawi silika let tiŋmba nu kasbur wak alonu ŋguimzaŋ kulenu kilmba nyumba taŋamba minna sulumba

pasa kuklimba saniŋgina: Ande nu ye ŋgumnemŋge prowamŋgat ta nu ye tuku saŋgri lite. Ye taŋgo mayenu kuga. Ye nu tugumŋge loka nu tuku kupe ŋgaro tuku muli kukliwam tuku wam ŋai ta mata ye nu mbolŋge kam kumuŋ kuga.
Ye tane kulembi kule pisnetiŋget. Nu tane Tukul Guwambi tane tuku ŋgamuŋgal kule pisne taŋaŋ tiŋgamŋgat ŋga saniŋgina.
Yohanusŋge Yesus kule pisnena le Satan nu Yesus tagona
Ait ta mbolŋge Yesus nu Galilea ma Nasaretŋge Yohanus tugum prona le Yohanusŋge nu Yordan kule mbolŋge kule pisnena.
Kule pisnena le nu tabek kina le pitik ndo samba talkina le Tukul Guwa gami taŋaŋ ndeka Yesus mbolŋge minna le kaŋgerna.
Taŋana le samba mbolŋge pasa ande promba teŋenmba sakina: Ne yiŋe Kiŋo. Ye ne tuku kume purmba ne tuku gare suŋgo tet ŋgina.
Nu kule pisne tina le kile ndo Tukul Guwa Yesus nu ma baknu mbol kuwa ŋga kukulmba sana le nu ndek kina.
Ma ta mbolŋge agaŋmor ŋguikok ndo minnaig. Nu kumba ka mara 40 taŋge minna le Satan nu pro ndek Yesus tago-tagona. Taŋawe deŋpurna le Kuate tuku eŋel ndeka Yesus sinzaŋnaig.
Yesus nu taŋgo bailkamba wike likina
Nane Yohanus muliŋtumba wandekŋge pilnaig le Yesus nu pro Galileaŋge Kuate tuku pasa mayenu kuklimba sakina:
Kile ait kumuŋgate le Kuate nu nuŋe gageu kulatkam tuku ait buk patukate. Tane ŋgamuŋgal biye mbilmba maŋau ŋaigonu kusreka pasa mayenu ismba son ŋgap ŋgina.
Kile Yesus nu Galilea kule kualiŋ make dubimba kumbaŋge nale aba nakile Simon le Andreus ndoŋ kumaŋ bukŋga minnaik le kaŋgerkina. Nale tuku piro ta kualegaŋ kilnaik tuku.
Yesus nu nale kaŋgerka ndek sanikina: Tale ye dubiyap le yeŋge tale tumtiki le taŋamba taŋgo kilamŋgaik ŋga sanikina.
Sanikina le nale pitik ndo tiŋga kumaŋ kusreka nu dubimba kinaik.
Yesus nu maŋ fudiŋmba kumba ka Sebedeus tuku kiŋo ar Yakobus nale maib nuŋe Yohanus ndoŋ kaŋgerkina. Nale nakile waŋ mbolŋge minyoka kumaŋ zailŋga minnaik le
nu kaŋgerka nale wikina le nale mam nakile Sebedeus nuŋe piro taŋgo ndoŋ waŋ mbol taŋge kusreka nu dubinaik.
Yesus nu taŋgo ande bukla ŋak wakeina
Nane kinaig ka Kaperneum tumbraŋ pronaig. Pro kusem ait mbolŋge Yesus nu kusem wandek sinam kumba taŋge nane pasa tumniŋmba minna.
Nu kusem pasa bitekŋganu mbalŋge pasa tumniŋgig taŋamba tum ndaniŋgina. Nu pasa miro taŋgo taŋaŋ pasa saniŋgina le nane ŋakmba pirerek purkinaig.
Naŋgine kusem wandek sinam taŋge taŋgo ande bukla ŋak minna.
Nu ndek witimba sakina: Yesus Nasaretnu, ne sine ndoŋ wamdus tuma kuga. Ne sine bale faram tuku prote e? Ne Kuate tuku Kiŋo ta ye kila ŋgina le
nu ndek bukla ta sawe lika sana: Ne maninka. Taŋgo ta kusremba mayok ka kaye ŋgina.
Taŋakina le bukla taŋgo ta kusrewam bafumba witimba ŋgarosu zulbarekŋga nu mayok ka nu kusremba kina le
nane ŋakmba ndek pirerek purka muŋgu kusnaŋginaig: Ame wam teŋen. Pasa te kitek. Nu saŋgri ŋak taŋaŋ bukla mata saniŋgit le nane nu tuku pasa isig ŋginaig.
Taŋamba Yesus tuku nyu Galilea ma ŋakmba kumuŋge likina.
Yesus nu guaze mbal gudommba wakeikina
Kile Yesus nane ndek kusem wande ta kusremba Yakobus le Yohanus kilmba ka Simon le Andreus tuku wande mbol kinaig ka taŋge
Simon magma nuŋe nu guaze ŋak ŋgaro pa tiŋgina le nu kinye ŋak minna le nane ndek Yesus kila sanaig.
Taŋakinaig le nu pro pino ta wainu biymba te-tina le ŋgaro pa tiŋgina ta mukumba nu mayekina. Taŋamba nu tiŋga nane tuku paguna.
Ki butuŋgam bafuna le nane afuŋge naŋgine mbal guaze tugu yimyam ŋak afu bukla ŋak ta kilmba mindeka Yesus tugum prowe likinaig.
Tumbraŋ ta tuku mbal ŋakmba wande mab taŋge maŋgurkinaig le
Yesus nu gudommba guaze tugu kise kise ŋak kile-tidiŋga bukla ŋaigonu ŋak ta pitaike likina. Bukla kame nane Yesus kila tukunu nu nane tuku miŋge pipniŋgina le nu tuku sa ndakinaig.
Yesus nu Galileaŋge pasa kuklina
Mafemba minna le Yesus nu aboŋga tiŋga mayok kumba ka ma yamokŋge Kuate ndoŋ pasata minna.
Pasata minna le Simon nane nu sotinaig.
Sota kumba ka taŋge nu te-silika sanaig: Nane ŋakmba ne sota kusnaŋgade ŋginaig le
nu ndek nane saniŋgina: Sine tiŋga tumbraŋ patuk patuk ta kab. Ye taŋge mata pasa kukliwamŋgit. Kuate nu ta tuku ye kukulyina ŋgina.
Taŋamba nu Galilea tumbraŋ ŋakmba mbolŋge lika naŋgine kusem wande mbolŋge pasa kukliwe lika bukla gudommba pitaike likina.
Yesus nu taŋgo ŋgirŋger ŋak wakeina
Taŋgo ande ŋgirŋger ŋak Yesus tugum promba dagol tidroŋga nu sarsarmba sana: O Suŋgo, ne kumuŋ. Ne nzalinuwa ndeta ye tuku ŋgarosu wakeiwa ŋgina le
nu taŋgo ta kaŋgermba sinamba ndek wai kuitka kiremba sana: Au. Ye ne wakeinet. Ne mayeka ŋgina.
Taŋakina le ŋgirŋger gagulka ŋgarosu mayekina le
Yesus nu kukulmba pasa saŋgrinu sana:
Ye ne mbolŋge maŋau kit te afu sa ndaniŋga. Ne mayekat tukunu ne kumba ka Moses tuku tukul dubimba atrau agaŋ pris tawe le atraukuwa le ŋakmba ne mayekat ta katesewaig ŋgina.

Taŋamba peuna ta nu kina ka wam ta saka saka likina. Ta tuku Yesus nu kile tumbraŋ sugo afu ŋgamukŋge ake likam kumuŋ kuga. Nu ma yamok ta mbolŋge ndo minanu le nane tumbraŋ tumbraŋ ŋakmba nu tugum prowe likanu.
